annotations.title: Apply Promo, Open-Hardware Grant, or VIP Beta Pass to Job

description: Apply a promo or grant code ('OPENHW' $0 open-hardware grant, 'PROTOTYPE1' $1 pass, 'FOUNDER100' -$100 credit, or 'XBUILDER' $0 VIP pass) to an unpaid compiled job_id. Call after calligraphy_compile_board when redeeming a code. Requires job_id and promo_code; returns JSON unlocked status and updated final_price_usd. Example: job_id='job_01', promo_code='OPENHW'.

customer_email.description: Engineering email address associated with the job or invite.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier string returned by calligraphy_compile_board.

promo_code.description: Case-insensitive promo or grant code (OPENHW, PROTOTYPE1, FOUNDER100, XBUILDER).

showcase_opt_in.description: Allow anonymized raster showcase preview for community gallery.

social_or_repo_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub or social URL verifying OPENHW project status.
